Karnataka launches cashless healthcare scheme for pensioners

The Karnataka Cabinet has approved the 'Sandhya Kiran' scheme, a new cashless healthcare initiative aimed at benefiting over 3 lakh pensioners in the state. The scheme was announced by the Karnataka government. The primary focus of the scheme is to provide healthcare access to pensioners.
